title: Crispy Sesame {p} with {v}
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Press the {p} for 15 minutes, then cut into 3/4-inch cubes.
Toss the {p} with a little oil and soy sauce, then a spoonful of cornstarch. Spread on a lined sheet without touching and bake 20 to 25 minutes, flipping once, until golden and crisp.
Warm the {spice} with the {sauce} in a small pan and toss the hot tofu in it.
Serve the {p} over the {s} with the {v}.
tip: Baking the tofu until crisp means no frying. Pile on the vegetable and go easy on the glaze.
